arrangement.notes: Boom Bap style instrumental with a slow build energy profile, modern sample chopping techniques used for sample layers. Mood is dark and the arrangement progressively increases energy.

sample_layer.description: Modern sample chopping techniques applied to sample layer, with channel names reflecting chopping methods.

sound_intent.sample_layer: Use modern chopping and slicing sample techniques to create rhythmically interesting percussive and melodic elements with a dark mood.
sound_intent.energy_profile: Slow build from low energy intro to high energy final hook.

channels.slice: Sample slices routed to dedicated slice channel for detailed processing.
channels.chop: Chopped samples routed separately for glitch effects.
channels.glitch: Glitch effects on chopped samples routed to own channel.
channels.stutter: Stuttered samples routed for rhythmic repetition.
channels.repeat: Repeated sample phrases isolated for layering.

track_roles.drums: Provide boom bap rhythm and groove using chopped and sliced drum samples.
track_roles.bass: Deliver deep, dark bassline supporting the groove.
track_roles.chords: Add harmonic content using chopped sampled chords.
track_roles.melody: Melodic elements created from chopped samples with minimal presence.
track_roles.fx: Effects layer with glitch, stutter, and sample manipulation effects.

designer_intent.focus: Creating an authentic boom bap instrumental with modern sample chopping techniques, emphasizing a dark mood and slow energy build across arrangement.

presetor_intent.goal: Render arrangement clearly while preserving dynamic and textured sample layers.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate and arrange boom bap drum patterns using sliced and chopped drum samples with dynamic energy build.

bass_generator.brief: Produce a dark, supportive bass line that complements the drum groove and supports the mood.

harmony_generator.brief: Create harmonic textures using chopped sample layers, focusing on dark chords and smooth transitions.

melody_generator.brief: Add subtle melodic elements from sample chops, enhancing atmosphere without overpowering rhythm.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement flow, ensuring slow energy build and consistent dark mood throughout the piece.

presetor.brief: Apply presets that emphasize clarity and punch in drums and bass, maintain sample layer texture.

songgps.brief: Guide structural layout and energy pacing to achieve effective slow build with clear section delineations.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix unprocessed channel audio preserving sample chopping detail and dynamic range with appropriate spatial effects.
